I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 10 June, which is the date she gave there herself.

I also told her I don't keep a separate record I can update. That means her earlier post in #north-team still shows the old date, so I suggested she correct it there. I didn't read #north-team, change anything or contact anyone else.
